feature_or_scope.description: Name of the cross-spec catalogue or scope this error-code document covers.

method.description: HTTP method. Omitted for cross-cutting sections that apply to multiple endpoints/methods rather than one route.

path.description: Route path for a single-endpoint section, or the section's free-text scope/label for cross-cutting sections (e.g. 'Rate Limiting (cross-cutting, API gateway)').

applies_to.description: Free-text note on which endpoints/methods a cross-cutting section applies to, when path is a scope label rather than a concrete route.

error_code.description: Omitted for rows with no machine-readable code (e.g. idempotent success responses, graceful-degradation responses).
